title: Record-and-skip machine
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a deterministic Turing machine with $k+2$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and states tagged by a Boolean phase. In the false phase its states are those of the record machine; when that machine reaches position $4k+4$, the phase changes to true and the machine enters the successor-field routine in its initial tag state. This is the phase-hosted machine built from the record machine and the skip reduction.
